newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Bucharest stocks mixed, high-caps down.
newsitem.headline: Bucharest stocks mixed, high-caps down.

text.p: Bucharest shares traded mixed on Monday, with most first-tier stocks slipping, as investors, bullish on the market for almost two weeks, were reluctant to buy at prices they viewed as too expensive.
"High-caps lost on average and closing quotes as local and foreign investors started to retreat due to their high prices," a trader said.
"There were also falls on the second tier and I think we're in for the downward correction we have been anticipating."
The market has been in a rally in recent sessions due to increased foreign interest after fresh foreign investment rules including brand-new provisions on portfolio deals.
Three independent market indices, the VAB, the BIG and the CAS-SE, based on average prices and market capitalisation, edged down by 1.9, 1.7 and 1.91 percent respectively from last Friday.
Nineteen stocks gained on average quotes, higher, 16 lost and three were flat. Six had no trade and two were suspended.
Volume was 3.7 million shares, down from 4.2 million and turnover fell four billion lei to 18.1 billion.
There were four special trades in Antibiotice pharmaceuticals and chemical plant Oltchim involving an overall 593,333 shares worth a total 3.5 billion lei.
On the first tier, Terapia was the only stock to close stronger, gaining 800 lei to 12,500.
Policolor dye maker and fertiliser maker Sofert marked time at 6,750 and 37,000 lei respectively.
Bourse attractions Azomures fertiliser maker and Oltchim lost 700 and 750 lei to 4,800 and 5,200 respectively.
Antibiotice and Compa vehicle parts maker slid closing at 10,000 lei -- 1,200 lei down -- and 2,850 lei -- 250 lei weaker. Arctic refrigerator maker remained suspended.
"Today's play in heavyweights was interesting, with large moves in prices," a broker said. "When quotes rose buy notes vanished, which only sent prices tumbling again."
